description:
Mesh-block codes inside a suburb. ``sal`` is required for now —
nationwide / by-LGA / by-SA3 listings will land later when there's
a story for the large payloads (a single LGA can hit a few
thousand mesh blocks).

**Price: 3¢ per call.**
